data.exact_reserve_text: Within the calendar year technical result, a surplus of GBP 3.8m (2017: deficit of GBP 2.0m) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years.
data.standardized_narrative: Opening gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2018 were GBP 267.622m. The syndicate reports a net prioryear surplus of GBP 3.8m relating to reassessment of claims from prior accident years (a favourable development / release). No gross prioryear strengthening amount is disclosed in the notes, so the reported net favourable movement has been used as the primary quantified prioryear movement.
raw_causal_phrases: surplus of GBP 3.8m (2017: deficit of GBP 2.0m) relates to the reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years
reassessment of net claims incurred for previous accident years

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: Gross opening claims outstanding taken from balance sheet (liabilities) at 31 Dec 2017. The report explicitly states a net prior-year surplus of GBP 3.8m; no gross (insurance liabilities) prior-year movement amount is provided in the notes. Per extraction rules, the net figure has been used as a fallback and flagged. A gross claims development triangle is present in the report but extraction of reliable per-cell gross development numbers from the provided text was not possible; therefore the triangle was not used to compute PYD. If a gross prioryear movement is required, the source document should be consulted for any note titled 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' or a detailed gross movement table.
